correctness.rationale: Finite objects defined explicitly by GP(10,2) and its line graph. Complete distance table has profile (60,120,120,120,15). Scale 1 has 20 pairwise edge-disjoint star triangles, yielding a wedge of 11 circles. Complete face-poset matchings at radii 2 and 3 leave exactly critical (0,2) cells, with all 3,330 and 83,730 Hasse covering incidences topologically sorted, so each stage is S² integrally. A 56-triangle orientable sphere subcomplex gives a shared integral cycle z, and two exact integral 2-cocycles checked on every 3-simplex evaluate to 1 and -1, proving a unit inclusion degree. At radius 4 complement nonedges are a perfect matching of 15 pairs, so the complex is S14, and at 5 it is a simplex. The attached verifier reproduces all counts and equations. No extrapolations or independent certification are claimed.

value.rationale: Natural explicit Archimedean extension of the Platonic-solid programme: the canonical icosidodecahedral graph, which is the line graph of the dodecahedron, has a structurally unexpected integral two-sphere persistence plateau across two different high-dimensional clique complexes, then an antipodal jump to S14. Proving the 2-to-3 inclusion degree is a unit is substantively stronger than computing the individual Betti numbers and gives the full barcode. It is a complete, motivated, exact classification of a canonical graph metric, not an arbitrary finite slice or mere recomputation.
